# PG01 owner handoff — exclusively post-G

**Gate:** do not edit production before the original G integrator pins an accepted combined source HEAD. Continue to use the original product source paths, not this proof prefix. Never merge the PG01 branch as a product implementation. PG01 is disposable design/test evidence.

1. **A — compiled source-attested EngineRegistry admission.** Targets: native/hqkg/src/engine.rs, core/programmability/src/{lib.rs,wire.rs}, existing tests. Bind reviewed in-repo source digest and unique owner/capability ID to a **precompiled pure** ComputeEngine; reject unsigned/unmapped manifest, unknown ABI, effect action/handler strings and capability downgrade. Preserve CAS/pinned leases and no dynamic arbitrary code loading. Include rollback/revoke future-generation receipt. Dependencies: F schema and B trusted actor/read; no plugin VM.
2. **A — typed DAG + bounded pure event fan-out on existing machinery.** Targets: native/hqkg/src/{typed_dag.rs,scoped_graph.rs,engine.rs} and existing source/graph cache interfaces. Add sourceEpoch/policy/source grant fences, immutable input snapshot and bounded independently scheduled pure subscribers; quantify queue, CPU, memory, output and late-result rules. Reuse HQKG Graph and Scheduler; no global command router, scheduler, database, Host write or independent graph. Detect blocked execute without advertising preemption.
3. **B — trusted native↔Host actor/source ingress and only effect authority.** Targets: apps/vivim-host/control/{dispatcher.mjs,journal.mjs,command-program.mjs} and existing Host/Tauri IPC integration owned jointly with A. Mint actor/session from trusted transport, revalidate source permission and current original text/catalog/policy/World revision at Submit, preserve approve/claim/receipt and uncertain send-once. Pure engine or N0 candidate must never execute a Host action.
4. **F — canonical versioned ABI and conformance.** Targets: contracts/interop/v1/{types.rs,types.ts,protocol.schema.json,validate.mjs}, existing tests and approved capability-manifest schema. Set stable serialized types for source attestation, engine generation/manifest digest, revision vector, typed pure status and redacted evidence; unify A two-domain namespace with F/N0 four domains by explicit mapping. Implement differential Rust/TS/JS negative fixtures; deny forged actor/claims and manifest effect. Do not grant with schema.
5. **E — inert visual subscription and stale-result refusal.** Targets: packages/tierflow/src/visual-runtime/command/{ir.ts,compile.ts} and the existing E World revision-guarded bridge; mobile PWA as remote Host client only. Subscribe to F-admitted read projections with exact actor/audience/input/source/policy/generation version; show partial/unknown/cancelled stale states, accessible text/IME parity and redaction. Reuse existing publisher; no second UI owner or offline effect replay.

**Release dependency order:** original G accepted HEAD -> F contract + A pure API -> B attested ingress/current grant -> E read-only visual gate -> F/G independent end-to-end security/Windows/PWA results. Original G and all other workers untouched by PG01.
